game.title: Cat Bond
game.freeze: Record exact deployed/selected source commit and confirm source-to-live parity before any capture. Recheck all copy against that commit.

copy.short: Collect adorable cats, explore illustrated regions, grow your garden, and build a two-cat team for real-time adventures.
copy.description: Start with a curious kitten and make the Sunlit Garden your own. Discover wild cats, explore beautifully illustrated regions, care for and train your companions, and build friendships as your cat family grows. Choose a two-cat team for real-time encounters, use skills and dodges in manual battles, or switch to Auto Battle for a more relaxed adventure. Discover rare companions, develop your collection in Catdex, and uncover shared memories as your cats grow closer.
copy.instructions: Choose a starter kitten, then click or tap the highlighted grass to meet a wild cat. Win encounters to welcome companions. Use the garden and Cats menus to care for and train your cats, choose a duo, and explore the world map. In battle, use the on-screen controls or select Auto Battle. Follow the in-game Controls guide for keyboard, mouse and touch inputs. Progress is saved locally in your browser.

globalGates: No paid tools, purchases, subscriptions or TinyFish; inspect free quota before executing chargeable tasks. If free quota cannot be verified, do not spend.
No public submit for review, publish, production deployment, or modification of Starbell Echo, main, original production files, or other games.
Every image and video must match frozen real Cat Bond build; no old V14/13 footage, generic AI art or invented mechanics.
No browser chrome, dev overlay, debug HUD, external promo, misleading seeded outcomes, clipped controls, duplicated scenes, language mixing or visibly low-quality imagery.
Inspect current portal specs/AI disclosure; use existing records and actual existing SDK credentials without exposing secrets; never guess review answers.

Test exact uploaded builds on real desktop/mobile UI, no fake PASS; record screenshot evidence, file sizes, hashes, source commit, version/date, portal save confirmation and remaining blockers per platform.
If not accessible, continue other independent platforms; do not misrepresent local packaging as portal draft completion.
